description: Defines test utilities for QUIC protocol, including a DelegatedPacketWriter class and functions to generate initial QUIC packet flights for testing.

classes.name: DelegatedPacketWriter
classes.description: A QuicPacketWriter implementation that delegates packet sending to a user-provided delegate.

methods.name: GetFirstFlightOfPackets
methods.description: Generates a vector of QuicReceivedPacket representing the first flight of a real HTTP/3 connection.

methods.name: GetAnnotatedFirstFlightOfPackets
methods.description: Generates annotated packets with additional session info for testing.
